run_multiview_3d_reconstruction: run the pulsar multiview 3D reconstruction example that optimizes sphere parameters and writes multiview.gif
create_scenemodel_for_pulsar_rendering: create a SceneModel nn.Module with learnable sphere positions, colors, radii, and opacity for pulsar rendering
render_scene_with_scenemodel_forward: render a 3D scene from default or custom camera parameters using SceneModel forward method
optimize_sphere_parameters_with_sgd: optimize sphere positions, colors, and radii using SGD to minimize pixel loss against reference images
prune_spheres_by_radius_and_color: prune spheres with small radii or near-white colors by moving them off-screen during optimization
